verdict.rationale: Foreloop offers an embeddable feedback widget (script tag or npm package) that lets users submit feedback without leaving the page, and routes it to a project or org feedback list — this satisfies the underlying capture-intake need but not literally via a 'link to a feedback portal' as the story describes; it's an in-page widget rather than a hyperlink/redirect. Missing for 10: explicit link-based/portal-redirect option, hosted portal page to link to, and any independent corroboration of the widget's UX.
